Kazuya Nakai (Japanese: 中井和哉 Nakai Kazuya) is a Japanese voice actor for and . He was born on November 25, 1967 in , .

==Pokémon roles==
Nakai started work during the middle of the original series, voicing characters of the day. However, in , he started voicing a recurring character, Nando.
